card.name: Purity grade wording for reagents
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected "grade", such as "pharmaceutical" or "HPLC" in purity descriptions of chemicals and water. Also fires partway through quality-standard terms like "parenteral" and "USP".

modes.label: Purity grade phrases
modes.description: A word or symbol right before "Grade" in a reagent or solvent purity description.
modes.example: cm x 0.7 cm MEK (methyl ethyl ketone [butanone]) (99.9 + % HPL<<C>> Grade) 0.9% aque

modes.label: Pharmaceutical quality terms
modes.description: The word "pharmaceutical" or "drinking" before grade or quality, describing material quality.
modes.example: The malathion of greater than<< pharmaceutical>>-grade purity used in malathion lotion

modes.label: Partway through standards words
modes.description: Inside words like parenteral or USP in injection and solution preparation text.
